tagline.en_US:
SnapOtter is an open-source, self-hosted file manipulation suite with 200+ tools across images, video, audio, PDFs, and files. It includes batch processing, reusable pipelines, local AI tools, a browser image editor, and a REST API so files stay on your own server.

This package uses SnapOtter's single-container embedded mode for an easy self-hosted server install. PostgreSQL 17 and Redis 8 run inside the container when DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL are left unset, with persistent data stored under /data.

Default login is admin / admin. SnapOtter asks you to change the default password after first login.

description.en_US: SnapOtter is a self-hosted file-processing suite that converts, compresses, edits, and transforms files directly in your browser. It includes over 200 tools across images, video, audio, PDFs, and data formats. The platform also features a layer-based image editor, local AI tools for OCR and transcription, automated processing pipelines, and a REST API.
